about: R3-EARTH-LINK EL3 (AC9): the comms station through a voyage. At Sol: the Listen pane (in beam, real time) and an empty Exchange log; a commit to Alpha Centauri, the panes again while cruising (in beam on the heard leg, Earth's rate astern); on arrival a re-plan to CNS5:1676, off Alpha Centauri's ray, so the ship flies out of beam (Earth has not heard the plan yet: the sim's reason and the silence line) with two plans in the log; the Listen pane again on arrival. make display-audit-comms audits every sampled frame (every digit on the panes an earth.* binding).
